Name: Bara Alex Anthro Overhaul
Author: tobyguilmon
Description:
Alex is one of my favorite character to romance and I didn't like his design in the Anthro mod. So made him into a cute hot bear inspired by the artist's character, Honeybum. The artist is called, "The Little Ghost Toast"

This replaces the original portraits and spritesheets of Alex in the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Mod [/url](Which is required)

Install:
Replace Alex's portraits and spritesheets in the Anthro Characters Mod with this mod.

Reference from:
[url=http://https://x.com/Saltypoundcake]The Little Ghost Toast

[/url]Note:
